decisions.reason: The same message independently specifies inspiring delivery, subtle pride, and no overacting, and those changes are already captured. Selecting Take Four does not necessarily cancel the existing energy, liveliness, or tone-reference attributes.
Changing the preferred take does not alter the requirement to deliver each track separately or the acceptability of MP3.

The message independently establishes the final-sentence pacing requirement and reports the excessive pauses in Take Four; both are already captured in the candidate history, with no additional state update or removal required.
